answer: The glacier edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 146 clones produces a signature the ferrous analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An adversary must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the knoll settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
